lines.text: The LORD says a man cannot hide in secret places, because He fills the heavens and the earth.
The prophets say "I had a dream!" hoping people will forget the LORD's name, as their fathers did through worshiping Molech.
The LORD says His word is like fire and like a hammer that smashes a rock.
The LORD is against prophets who buy words from the priests, and He says He sent them.

wrong_details.true: He says He did not send or command them

lines.text: Those who claim "the burden of the LORD" will be forgotten and cast out, and they will bear everlasting shame.
